zh: 翻译新增免费模式和自定义 API。整条回复的译文可直接显示在消息内。
翻译连接测试显示模型和响应时间。
划词翻译支持跨区块、表格选区和手机预览。翻译表格内容时会一并发送对应列标题。
标准模式新增工作卡片，集中展示工具操作和文件修改。
工作步骤支持编号和分类筛选。桌面端使用侧边面板，手机端使用抽屉。
任务详情新增计划步骤。归档时可选择是否包含子任务。
补充显示 Codex 子任务的模型和推理力度信息。
优化时间线性能，减少流式更新中的重复计算。
改进 Codex 内容渲染和跨平台路径处理。自定义标题生成模型采用更严格的权限限制。
此前贡献：支持由匹配的插件渲染 ui / app 代码块回复 (#19 BY @HybridRbt)。
此前贡献：修正安装命令中的插件 ID 大小写 (#27 BY @Calcium-Ion)。
en: Translation adds a free mode and custom API support. Full-reply translations can be displayed inline.
Translation connection tests show the model and response time.
Selection translation supports blocks, table cells, and mobile previews. Table translations also send the relevant column headers.
Standard mode adds work cards for tool actions and file changes.
Work steps are numbered and can be filtered by type. Open them in a desktop side panel or mobile drawer.
Task details now show plan steps. Archive a task alone or with its subtasks.
Display model and reasoning effort information for Codex subagents.
Improved timeline performance by reducing repeated work during streaming.
Improved Codex content rendering and cross-platform path handling. Custom title-generation models use tighter permission restrictions.
Earlier contribution: Allow matching plugins to render replies with ui / app code blocks (#19 BY @HybridRbt).
Earlier contribution: Correct plugin ID casing in installation commands (#27 BY @Calcium-Ion).
